recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-12645 unless a future Patient Care decision reopens which request resources CarePlan activity references should allow.
issue_request: FHIR-12645 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request for DSTU2 asking to change CarePlan.activity.reference from ProcessRequest to Task because ProcessRequest was being reduced in scope and Task was the better CarePlan activity target.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-12645, but the March 2017 FMG Zulip thread records that GF#12645 had initially been applied incorrectly by removing ProcedureRequest instead of ProcessRequest. Git commit c0df469417 corrected the old CarePlan spreadsheet source by removing ProcessRequest from CarePlan.activity.reference while keeping Task and restoring ProcedureRequest; a follow-up workflow Zulip thread confirmed Task was then present in the current build.
additional_context: CarePlan remains active in source/fhir.ini, Task is active, and ProcessRequest is commented out with the deleted-resource note 'ProcessRequest=approved use Task'. The current source now uses the successor element CarePlan.activity.plannedActivityReference, whose allowed target profiles include Task and omit ProcessRequest. A direct search found no remaining ProcessRequest reference under source/careplan.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active CarePlan StructureDefinition and build configuration already preserve the requested replacement, and a source edit would be redundant rather than corrective.
